confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because Aomori's hotel supply and July rates vary and are not well documented in my knowledge. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the typical local relationship to draft beer because direct knowledge is weak. Early-August Nebuta festival demand is outside the July window, but late-July rates may run slightly above ordinary levels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional prefectural city in Tohoku, priced below Tokyo and roughly in line with other mid-sized Tohoku cities such as Morioka and Hirosaki. Yen-denominated price levels were converted to USD using an assumed exchange rate near 150 JPY per USD.
